propositions: A cancelled or timed-out mutation job casts Verified -1 with only 'CANCELLED: <url>' message, carrying no triage signal to distinguish timeout from other failure modes or to guide author action.

The gerrit-review-action hardcodes its message template as '${STATUS}: ${SERVER_URL}/${REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${RUN_ID}' with no input for custom text, and comment-only flag only suppresses labels without enabling message customization.

Job timeout status is reported only in GitHub check-run annotations (not in job conclusion field), requiring reads: check permission to detect and communicate that a job exceeded its execution time budget.

The fix posts triage detail as a comment-only Gerrit review via direct SSH 'gerrit review --message' (no label, no vote change) after the vote is cast, guarded on non-success outcomes and continue-on-error to preserve vote immutability.
